page.content:
Artist who designed the xenomorph and the derelict.

How H. R. Giger connects

  • Concept: Xenomorph — H. R. Giger designed the xenomorph.
  • Work: Alien (1979) — Giger's designs produced the look of Alien (1979).

What is H. R. Giger?

H. R. Giger designed the xenomorph, the Space Jockey derelict, and the biomechanical nightmare that made Alien's creature unique.

Key threads lead to Xenomorph and Alien (1979).
